body: ## Summary - **`docs: v0.6.5 release notes`** (`10b2c271b`) and **`docs: v0.6.5 release notes in user terms`** (`ab143a4c5`): Adds `## [0.6.5] - 2026-10-27` and `## [0.6.4] - 2026-10-27` (noting `0.6.4` was not published because the tag was pushed before the version bump, and its fixes ship in `0.6.5`) to `CHANGELOG.md`, and adds `` + `### 0.6.5` to `README.md`, written in user terms. - **`release: 0.6.5`** (`20525bd84`): Bumps `[workspace.package] version` in `Cargo.toml` from `0.6.3` to `0.6.5` and refreshes the 13 workspace package entries in `Cargo.lock`. - **`docs(reports): v0.6.5 release notes report`** (`4a5d62ef4`, plus the Round 2 report commit): Adds `plans/reports/agy-r065-release-notes.md` and `plans/reports/agy-r065-release-notes-evidence/`. - Every change in `0.6.5` came through its own reviewed PR since `v0.6.3` (`fbc51addd`). The four `v0.6.4` fixes (`#1236`, `#1237`, `#1238` and `#1239`) appear twice in `v0.6.3..origin/release/v0.6.5` across the two lineages and are listed once below; `#1213` appears once. ## Changes in 0.6.5 | PR | Issue | Summary | |---|---|---| | #1213 | Refs #1192 | Home › `Import` › `Enter a path…` expands `~` and `~/…`, decodes percent-encoded `file://` links, refuses relative paths, and starts toast timers on the first painted frame | | #1236 | Fixes #1171 | Clears a tab's scrollback when an agent redraws on a UI zoom or terminal resize so output no longer repeats | | #1237 | Fixes #1193 | Repaints the canvas frame label after an agent rename via `designos-mcp` and keeps component and child shape names independent | | #1238 | Fixes #1194 | Changes a Codex tab's status from `Working…` to `Done` after 1.5 s of quiet after a turn ends and hides `Stop` | | #1239 | Fixes #1197 | Cuts canvas frame, component and instance name labels with `…` to fit the frame width like Figma | | #1247 | Fixes #1195 | Shows `Show prompt` on the current waiting tab to focus its terminal prompt, and switches tabs from `Open tab` when another tab is waiting | | #1249 | Fixes #993 | Large multi-layer edits, such as command-palette auto-fix on a big design-system page, finish faster because Studio records only the layers that changed | | #1252 | Fixes #1212 | Gives a new library (and an existing library once on its first launch of 0.6.5) the `DESIGN-OS Studio Starter` file in `Getting started` without touching existing files, adds `Open starter sample`, opens Home on no-arg launch, and removes the older built-in samples, `--seed-library`, release `--fixture` and `examples/` | | #1253 | Fixes #1140 | Exports one variable mode as a single DTCG `.tokens.json` file (`--mode`, `--collection`, `--resolve-aliases`, `--color-format`), with unique names for same-named collections | | #1255 | Fixes #1165 | Hides deleted, soft-deleted and orphan style records from style pickers, Assets, layer chips and MCP listings while keeping layer appearance and style links on `.fig` save, and names empty-named listed styles `Unnamed style` | | #1257 | Fixes #1121 | Enforces one 512 MiB import file size limit returning `FILE_TOO_LARGE` (`safe_to_retry: false`) and lists `--version` in `designos-mcp` usage | | #1258 | Fixes #1003 | Returns `INVALID_NAME` on blank, whitespace-only or control/direction-control output names and `NAME_TOO_LONG` on path components over 255 UTF-8 bytes in `designos_save_file`, `designos_render_png` and `designos_export_fig_file` | | #1259 | Fixes #1127 | Addresses a node by name, id or Figma id (`id:`, `fig:`, `name:`, `none`) in `--select`, supports `--zoom fit`, and exits 2 without writing on a miss | | #1254 | Fixes #1154 | Measures hug and fixed-width `NodeSpec` text with the text renderer instead of a character-count width estimate, honouring `font_family` and returning `TEXT_MEASURED_WITH_FALLBACK_FONT` on font fallback (CI running on `release/v0.6.5`) | | #1251 | Fixes #1043 | Imports `.fig` files with 64-bit values that use the top bit (such as some stroke seeds) without corrupting the rest of the file, and no longer writes an invalid 10-byte number on export (CI running on `release/v0.6.5`) | | #1256 | Fixes #1242 | Scales icons and vectors inside resized component instances in an imported `.fig` with the instance (stroke weight unchanged), and keeps strokes on stroke-only icons (CI running on `release/v0.6.5`) | ## Verification - `git diff --stat origin/release/v0.6.5..HEAD` touches only `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `plans/reports/agy-r065-release-notes.md`, and `plans/reports/agy-r065-release-notes-evidence/*`. - `git diff --stat 10b2c271b..20525bd84` touches only `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock`. - `cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps --locked` reports `{'0.6.5'}` across all 13 workspace crates. - `cargo build -p designos-diff --locked` under an isolated `HOME`/`TMPDIR` harness succeeded (`0` warnings, `10.08s`), and `designos-diff --version` printed `designos-diff 0.6.5`. - `cargo fmt --all -- --check` exited `0`. - Full verification report: `plans/reports/agy-r065-release-notes.md`.
